name: Spynel-S 6000 panoramic IR (HGH)
description: Passive rotating MWIR sensor that rebuilds a 360 deg thermal panorama every 2 s and cues itself. Wide-area search, no radar needed. UAS ranges are planning figures: HGH publishes DRI for people and vehicles only.

classifyRangeM.condition: RECOGNITION range for a HUMAN target, used only as a bound — PROXY, NOT A UAS FIGURE. HGH publishes Spynel-S 6000 human recognition at 2 km (Johnson criterion, STANAG). No UAS recognition or identification range exists in any source. 2000 m is used as a representative classification ring because it is the OEM's own recognition figure for the smallest published target class, which bounds a Group 1 UAS from above.
classifyRangeM.source: SPYNEL SERIES Wide Area Surveillance Solutions leaflet
classifyRangeM.note: Inventory records 2000 m (2 km) at MANUFACTURER_CLAIM (for the human figure) / INFERRED (as a UAS proxy) REPRESENTATIVE; the seed leaves the field null

sectorDeg.source: HGH Spynel-S product page (curl), Spynel-S 6000 column

elevationDeg.source: HGH Spynel-S product page (curl), Spynel-S 6000 column

rangeAccuracyM.note: Passive imager with no rangefinder documented: bearing only; not established by the public record.

azimuthAccuracyDeg.note: Planning factor: about two IFOV of the Spynel-S 6000 (0.15 x 0.15 mrad per the HGH Spynel-S leaflet), 0.3 mrad or 0.017°, rounded to 0.02°; HGH publishes no angular accuracy.

elevationAccuracyDeg.note: Planning factor: about two IFOV of the Spynel-S 6000 (0.15 x 0.15 mrad per the HGH Spynel-S leaflet), 0.3 mrad or 0.017°, rounded to 0.02°; HGH publishes no angular accuracy.

pixelPitchUm.note: Planning factor: the HGH leaflet gives a cooled MWIR 640 x 512 FPA and no pitch; 640 x 512 cooled MWIR cores are a 15 µm format.

focalLengthMm.note: Planning factor: HGH publishes the IFOV (0.15 mrad, Spynel-S 6000) but no focal length. With the assumed 15 µm pitch, 15 µm / 0.15 mrad = 100 mm. Fixed lens; there is no zoom stop on this rotating sensor.

detectorPixelsH.condition: MWIR 640 x 512 FPA mounted with the 640 px column vertical (panorama 46 000 H x 640 V), so 512 px span the instantaneous horizontal field
detectorPixelsH.source: HGH Spynel-S leaflet (SPS-Len-al1, PDF), Spynel-S 6000 column

fovDeg.condition: instantaneous horizontal field of the rotating head: 512 px × 0.15 mrad IFOV = 77 mrad = 4.4°; VFOV 5°; the head rotates at 0.5 rps for the 360° panorama recorded in sectorDeg
fovDeg.source: HGH Spynel-S leaflet (SPS-Len-al1, PDF), Spynel-S 6000 column

mrtdMk.note: Planning factor: HGH publishes no MRTD or NETD. Cooled MWIR cores publish NETD of 20 mK (Lynred Daphnis-HD MW), <25 mK (Teledyne FLIR Neutrino SX12) and <30 mK (DRS HexaBlu 1280-MW); the 25 mK median is used as the low-spatial-frequency MRTD.

eoBand.value: thermal: MWIR 640 x 512 focal plane array
eoBand.source: HGH Spynel-S product page (curl), Spynel-S 6000 column
